plan(CC-0116): scope service DB credentials per ControlPlane

Capture the plan to move each Keystone instance off the shared, flat
OpenBao path (`openstack/keystone/db`) and onto credentials scoped per
ControlPlane and per database. The current single source secret gives
every tenant's Keystone the same password, so rotation or compromise
has a fleet-wide blast radius. This work brings service DB credentials
in line with the per-ControlPlane scoping CC-0112 already established
for the admin credential.
